summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated on is_terminal only; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added to tests/test_console.py (skips on legacy Windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). CHANGELOG.md gained an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests and mypy have not been run, so they are unverified.
